title_zh: 從 45 秒日常對話偵測青少年思覺失調高風險：LEMon-AID 框架
title_en: LEMon-AID emotion-informed AI detection of youth psychosis risk from speech
summary_zh: 新加坡團隊發表研究，直接叫大型語言模型從日常對話預測風險，表現與隨機猜測無異。新框架先抽取喜悅、信任、恐懼等情緒特徵再結合傳統機器學習，準確率由 55% 升至 67%，敏感度最高可達 93%。仍需進一步臨床驗證。
summary_en: A Singapore team (NTU and the Institute of Mental Health) reported in npj Mental Health Research that asking an LLM to predict psychosis risk directly from 45-second everyday speech samples performed no better than chance, while their LEMon-AID framework (emotion features plus traditional machine learning) raised accuracy from 55% to 67%, with sensitivity up to 93%. Further clinical validation is needed.
evidence_note: 同儕審查期刊模型評估研究，單一樣本，未經臨床場景驗證

ethics_flags.note: 以語音情緒特徵標記青少年「高風險」，假陽性可能造成標籤與不必要介入；語音資料本身屬敏感個人資料。
refs: 評估與篩檢｜假陽性與標籤效應

caution: 敏感度 93% 的設定下特異度與假陽性率未在摘要中交代；高敏感度篩檢會帶來標籤與焦慮成本，不能作診斷或入學／就業用途。
brief_zh: 429 名 14–29 歲參加者，每人提供 45 秒非表露性談話樣本
直接用 LLM 預測風險，表現與隨機猜測無異
LEMon-AID 準確率由 55% 升至 67%，敏感度最高 93%
supervision_questions: 若機構引入高敏感度篩檢工具，我們的假陽性跟進流程與家長溝通話術準備好了嗎？

posts.title: Emotion-focused AI spots early signs of psychosis in youths from short speech samples
posts.content: 新加坡團隊在《npj Mental Health Research》發表研究，用大型語言模型從 45 秒日常對話中抽取情緒特徵，偵測青少年思覺失調高風險。

related.title_zh: 居家認知測試平板 App：與紙筆版同樣可靠且數據更豐富
related.title_en: At-home tablet cognitive testing app versus paper testing
related.summary_zh: 美國東北大學團隊發表研究，讓認知健康長者在家的平板上完成連線測驗、畫鐘等任務。平板版與紙筆版結果一致，而且能記錄顫抖等微互動訊號。下一步將擴大測試人數。
related.summary_en: Northeastern University researchers reported in JMIR Formative Research that cognitively healthy older adults completed tablet-based cognitive tests (trail-making, clock drawing) at home with results consistent with paper versions, while the app captured richer micro-interaction data such as tremor. Participants tested twice over Zoom, two months apart, for test-retest reliability.
